Zombie Run, Haunted Hayrides & Enchanted Forests: A Spooktacular Time in Janesville

Get into the Halloween spirit with spooky season adventures for the whole family! Little ones can wander through the Enchanted Forest, following a narrated path through the hillside filled with favorite fairy tales, nursery rhymes, and children’s books brought to life. For a little more screen-time fun, hop aboard the Hollywood Hayride and travel through scenes inspired by family-friendly TV shows and movies. Hours are Wednesday & Thursday, October 7 & 8 from 5:30 - 8 PM and Friday & Saturday, October 9 & 10 from 5:30 - 8:30 PM.

Enchanted Carraige.jpg

JanesvilleSpooky.jpg

Ready for something a little more mysterious? Head to the historic Milton House after dark for Histories and Mysteries: A Paranormal Investigation. Learn paranormal investigation techniques, use research equipment, and explore the historic 1844 house in search of anything that may still linger within its walls. There’s no guarantee of paranormal activity—but you never know what you might uncover when the lights go out! Come to the Milton House after dark for this paranormal event. Wisconsin's only certified Underground Railroad site open for tours and a National Historic Landmark. Observe a paranormal investigation inside the historic Milton House walls. Choose from one of two time slots: 7 PM - 8:15 PM or 8:30 PM - 9:45 PM. *Please note: There are TWO separate times that this event is being offered, both on October 16th. Please verify that you are signing up for your preferred time when purchasing tickets.

Enhanced-NR2.jpg

For a Halloween adventure with a little more adrenaline, join the Downtown Zombie Run during Janesville’s Downtown Halloweekend. Race through downtown in the 5K Zombie Run while dodging the undead, or take a more leisurely—but still zombie-filled—1 Mile Zombie Walk. Downtown Janesville Halloweekend returns October 24, filling the downtown area with a full day of familyfriendly Halloween fun—from trickortreating with local businesses to lively themed activities along the riverfront. Kids can collect treats and join the Monster Mash Bash dance party. Explore additional popup happenings and seasonal surprises throughout the area. With easy walkability, plenty of costumes, and a festive downtown atmosphere, it’s a simple, highenergy way to celebrate Halloween in the heart of Janesville. From family-friendly frights to paranormal mysteries and zombie-filled streets, there’s no shortage of ways to celebrate Halloween in Wisconsin’s Great Outside.

Plan your trip today!

Enchanted Forest and Hollywood Hayride - 10/7/26-10/10/26 5:30 PM-8:30 PM

Histories and Mysteries: A Paranormal Investigation - 10/16/26 7:00 PM-10:00 PM

Downtown Zombie Run - 10/24/26 5:30 PM-7:30 PM
